register.description: Clock Control Secured Register. This register is used for enabling clock to the module.

bitfield.description: Write this bit to enable clock to the module
Write this bit to enable host interface clock
Write this bit to enable counter clock
This bit is set to disable all clock sources.
when 1b, indicates that the module is active and busy with processing data and tokens.
When 1b indicates the Host interface is active and busy with Host bus transfers.
When 1b, indicates that the counter clock domain is active. This signal is always asserted (set to '1'), except when the counter module is in reset (ctr_reset_n set to '0').
Reads to this field return zero, writes to this field are ignored.

register.description: Soft Reset Control. This register is used for controlling soft reset mechanism.

bitfield.description: Write this bit to request soft reset. It is a write-clear or auto clear register.
when 1b, indicates abort request is acknowledged by EIP and soft reset is asserted
Write 1b, to forcely assert soft reset without waiting for abort acknowledge from EIP.
When 1b, soft reset is asserted to the module
Reads to this field return zero, writes to this field are ignored.
It indicates state of soft reset assertion.

register.description: PKA Abort Control Secured Register. This register is used for aborting PKA operation.

bitfield.description: Write 1 to Abort.

bitenum.token: Write 1 to this bit to abort PKA operation
bitenum.description: Write 1 to this bit to abort PKA operation

bitfield.description: This bit is used to mask PKA abort request generated by non-secure controller.
Reads to this field return zero, writes to this field are ignored.

register.description: Debug Control. This register is used for HSM memory and asset debug through OCP only if TI debug access is enabled

bitfield.description: This register enables debug through OCP. To enable FIFO0 , bit0 should be set. To enable FIFO1 , bit1 should be set. To enable MBIN , bit2 should be set. To enable MBOUT, bit3 should be set. To enable OTP , bit4 should be set. To enable DRAM , bit5 should be set. To enable PROM , bit6 should be set.
Reads to this field return zero, writes to this field are ignored.

register.description: DFT Control. This register is used for enabling FRO controls if TI test access is enabled

bitfield.description: Reads to this field return zero, writes to this field are ignored.

Active HIGH enable signal for FRO characterization (enables the tst_fro_select, tst_fro_enable and tst_fro_delay inputs). This is a combinatorial function. The TRNG module clocks do not need to run for this to work.
Active HIGH enable signal for FRO selected by tst_fro_select
Delay chain length selection for FRO selected by tst_fro_select. This input should only be changed while tst_fro_enable is LOW.
FRO selection input. A selected FRO will have its fro_testin input forced low. Valid value to select FRO's is 0-7.

register.description: Clock FRO Divide Configuration. This register is used for controlling FRO clock measurements.

bitfield.description: It is used for dividing FRO clock withe the division value specified by this register. Division value should be from 2-80.
It is write enable signal used for loading division value onto divider. It should be disable and re-enable after changing the mem_value
Reads to this field return zero, writes to this field are ignored.
power_mode_in override value by FW. FW can set to 1 after cold boot
power_mode_in source select MMR 0-power_mode_in comes from logic 1-power_mode_in comes from mem_slp_ovr_val
Reads to this field return zero, writes to this field are ignored.
